messages:
deploy-bot: starting rollout v1.13.1 -> eu1 (change window 02:00-04:00 UTC). Running post-deploy smoke and synthetic probes.
alex: saw synth liveness probe start failing at 02:06 UTC, initial failure batch ~1.2% error rate, now 3%.
jessica: picking up graphs https://dash.redwood.internal/d/serving/eu1-smoke?from=now-15m
alex: probe sample + errors:
alex: ```
2026-04-02T02:05:58Z synth req=ok
2026-04-02T02:06:12Z synth req=err code=503 id=aa7f
2026-04-02T02:06:25Z synth req=err code=503 id=bb3c
2026-04-02T02:06:40Z synth p95=820ms err_rate=3.1%
```
maya: v1.13.1 included KV warmup timing adjustments and a kernel-selector ordering change for quantized exec. could be overlapping side effects.
rahul: any upstream 503 spikes from inference-proxy?
samira: yes, proxy logs show a cluster of 503->200 retries during 02:06-02:07
samira: ```
[02:06:13] proxy: upstream retry=3 status=503->200 latency=512ms req_id=aa7f
[02:06:23] proxy: upstream retry=2 status=503->200 latency=498ms req_id=bb3c
```
liam: threshold for liveness smoke is err_rate < 0.5% and p95 < 400ms — we're over both
jessica: recommend immediate regional rollback/pin for eu1 to v1.13.0 and pause the rest of the rollout. also notify release-window owners.
alex: +1 — don't blast the kernel-selector tweak to other regions until we understand
liam: attempting /deploy pin-route eu1 v1.13.0 --reason post-deploy-synth-liveness-spike
liam: deploy-bot: error: permission denied to run pin-route (you need pinner role)
oncall-bot: @liam you can request a pin via /deploy request-pin eu1 v1.13.0 — ping the oncall rotation to approve
liam: running /deploy request-pin eu1 v1.13.0
rahul: while pin is pending, can we scale kv-warmup threads and re-run probes to see if transient?
maya: scaling kv-warmup up by 2x in eu1 now for 5m
samira: pin request approved by oncall, applying pin now: /deploy pin-route eu1 v1.13.0 --approved-by=oncall
deploy-bot: routing pin applied: eu1 -> v1.13.0 by oncall. Rollout to other regions paused.
jessica: posting to #release-notes: eu1 rolled back to v1.13.0 after post-deploy synth liveness/error spike; team collecting traces; hold on global rollout.
jessica: https://docs.redwood.internal/releases/v1.13.1/notes
alex: enabling short-lived debug logs for kernel-selector and kv-warmup on eu1 for correlation ids aa7f, bb3c
maya: captured traces, initial look shows increased kernel-fallbacks for quantized exec on first few requests after warmup window
rahul: next steps: 1) correlate fallback spikes with probe ids, 2) if confirmed, revert ordering in kernel-selector and ship v1.13.2 hotfix; 3) re-run small canary in us-west
liam: scheduling a quick postmortem sync in 30m and adding owners to the ticket
samira: created ticket INF-4521 with logs and sample request ids
deploy-bot: post-deploy summary: eu1 pinned back to v1.13.0, probes and alerting active, verbose traces captured. Close thread and move to infra-investigations. :white_check_mark:
